title: Daily Stand-up
author: Hive
intro: 这是一次团队的每日站会。开发者汇报昨天完成的工作和今天的计划，说明遇到的阻碍，组长主动提出帮忙，最后双方约定如何拆分并提交代码审查。你可以任选组长或开发者的角色朗读。
tips: 汇报时先说结论，再补充细节，句子之间的停顿要短。
staging、token 等技术词要读清楚，重音落在第一个音节。

glossary.staging: 预发布环境，上线前测试用的服务器
glossary.token: 令牌，此处指登录链接里的凭证
glossary.pair: 结对编程，两人一起写代码

segments.speaker: Lead
segments.text: Morning, everyone. Let's do a quick stand-up. What did you finish yesterday?

segments.speaker: Developer
segments.text: Yesterday I finished the login form validation, and I wrote tests for the email field.

segments.speaker: Lead
segments.text: Nice work. What are you planning to do today?

segments.speaker: Developer
segments.text: Today I'm working on the password reset page, but I'm a little stuck on the email link.

segments.speaker: Lead
segments.text: What's the problem with the link? Is it not opening, or is it going to the wrong page?

segments.speaker: Developer
segments.text: The link works locally, but in staging it expires too fast, so users get an error message.

segments.speaker: Lead
segments.text: That sounds like a configuration issue. Have you checked the token lifetime setting?

segments.speaker: Developer
segments.text: I did, and it's set to five minutes, but I don't have permission to change it.

segments.speaker: Lead
segments.text: I'll change that setting this afternoon. Do you want me to pair with you on the email template after that?

segments.speaker: Developer
segments.text: That would be great, thanks. Could we meet at two, and I'll share my screen?

segments.speaker: Lead
segments.text: Sounds good. When you finish, please open a pull request so Sam can review it.

segments.speaker: Developer
segments.text: Sure. Should I keep the change small, or should I include the new error page too?

segments.speaker: Lead
segments.text: Keep it small. Let's send the error page in a separate pull request, so the review is faster.

segments.speaker: Developer
segments.text: Agreed. I'll open the first one before lunch, and I'll tag Sam for the review.

segments.speaker: Lead
segments.text: Perfect. Thanks, everyone. Let's meet again tomorrow at nine.
